image_description: A large African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on a muddy riverbank with its mouth slightly open. The crocodile's body is elongated and heavily armored with visible scutes. The head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout. The eyes are positioned dorsally on the head. The limbs are short and stout with webbed feet. The tail is laterally compressed and muscular. The background consists of muddy ground with some vegetation.
